reasoning: The banana leaf shows multiple discrete oval-to-elliptical lesions with dark brown/black necrotic centers surrounded by yellowish halos, scattered across an otherwise green leaf. This pattern — well-defined oval spots with dark centers and yellow margins on banana leaves — is characteristic of Cordana Leaf Spot (Cordana musae). Panama Disease causes wilting/yellowing without discrete spots, Bunchy Top shows vein streaking, Cigar End Rot affects fruit, and Sigatoka typically produces more streaky or elongated lesions along the veins rather than these distinct oval spots.
